subject: Ogre
picture: A huge clumsy ogre is jammed on a tight spiral dungeon stair. His shoulders press the center pillar and the outer wall. Knees bent, one giant foot hanging off a small step. In one hand he holds a large thick tree-branch club, almost as long as his torso. The spiral rail is a simple smooth wooden rail with plain posts. Stone steps as large slabs, center pillar, stone ceiling, closed wooden door at the bottom. One head, one torso, two arms, two hands, two legs, two feet. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
